title: Make attention findings specific, deduplicated and actionable
description: Owner sees six vague attention cards: MESSAGE_BACKLOG, three indistinguishable WORKTREE_PROBLEM, ONE-DISK RECOVERABILITY and duplicate unacknowledged message count. Show human-readable problem, owning agent, branch/path, severity and actual consequence. Deduplicate the same message queue, group worktree issues by identity, distinguish normal ahead/unique commits from broken operations or unprotected work. Offer contextual quick actions when supported: owner approval/rejection with existing preview-confirm/revision/evidence checks, open exact message/thread, inspect exact worktree, request owning-agent review or retry a qualified operation. Non-owner approvals must not gain approve buttons. No generic dismiss, mass acknowledgement, automatic merge/cleanup or silent remote push. Actions must preserve drafts under refresh and report pending/error/unknown honestly.
acceptanceCriteria: Overview shows exact condition and responsible identity instead of repeated opaque codes
Duplicate message finding is one actionable card
Approve/reject appears only for an owner-addressed pending approval and uses current revision/evidence preview and explicit confirmation
Worktree progress is not falsely presented as a broken repository; unsafe recovery remains visible
Quick actions route to exact entities and cannot silently merge, acknowledge peers, publish or delete
Regression covers stale decision, wrong approver, duplicate findings, no available action, failure and refresh while editing
